# oncall_resources (Data Source)

Lists the RBAC resource names and verbs this oncall install knows about (GET /admin/resources), useful for building a custom role's permissions list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oncall_resources" "rbac" {}

output "rbac_resources" {
  value = data.oncall_resources.rbac.resources
}

output "rbac_verbs" {
  value = data.oncall_resources.rbac.verbs
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `resources` (List of String) Every guarded resource name, e.g. "schedules", "triggers", "integrations".
- `verbs` (List of String) Every RBAC verb, e.g. "view", "write", "delete", "share".
